runtime_uncertainties: Six exact cases, 24 candidates, five comparisons and three fixed physical speed grids have CPU source proofs. Actual Native motion, following-traffic interaction, four-view visibility, governing speed-sign authority and legal judgments remain unverified until capture.
The requested speed endpoints and grid spacing are engineering coverage samples, not legal cutoffs for normal and reasonable movement or necessity.

evidence_review.method: Read frozen exact statutory text, cell and actor from assignment.json and accepted-recording inventory from evidence.json. No accepted recordings are listed for this assignment.

gaps.requirement: Compare slow travel with measured traffic impedance; separately cover reduced speed necessary for safety and compliance with law. Keep “normal and reasonable movement” and “necessary” as judgment phrases, without numeric legal cutoffs.
gaps.why_existing_insufficient: The frozen evidence inventory lists no accepted recordings for this assignment.
